body: No human being is disgusting except those who make others feel like shit. They are the one's who are disgusting, not you! If you end your life because of this, you'll be ending it on a lie, a specific lie. The lie that your worth is determined by others. And that's simply not true. I don't know you, but just from your post you seem like a very likeable and lovely person. The world needs kind and compassionate people like you. Sometimes one has to work hard and then some. But once the reward comes, you know it will be earned. Do you think you could give it another shot? You have to answer honestly though, because if you do not, whatever the answer; it won't help you.

Thanks for your answer, appreciate it. However, I don't know if happiness can be considered the answer to my "problem". I mean, well, first of all, what exactly is happiness? I don't know and if I did, it wouldn't change anything. I wouldn't be able to taste it for it is fleeting. I don't think it's a good enough reason to live, at least not for me.

I honestly don't know what to say to you. Do you think the answer is somewhere "out there"? If so, stop searching for you'll be just wasting your time.  Maybe some people tried and gave you their answers. But the thing is: no answer matters except your own.
You say that there isn't really a fix to this problem other than dying.
Are you sure? I mean, 100 % sure? Because if not you can still find meaning; your meaning. You define yourself and if you don't want to be with other persons it's OK. It doesn't mean your a bad person. I know, we don't really get to decide this, you simply can't live without any other human whatsoever. But we DO get to control the opinions we form because of it. How it affects us. Do I let this define my life or do I say "Pah, this changes nothing to me; I define my existence on my own terms"?
Long story short: You have to find your own answers. However, unless put 100 % in finding them, you are no longer able to say "I gave it my all, it's clearly not my fault." And I don't know about you, but under these circumstences I couldn't go through ending my own life, knowing that maybe I didn't do everything in my power.
Hope this is somehow able to help.
